label: Declassified

szenen.text: The U.S. *secretly* read Soviet spy messages for decades.

archiv.datei: File:Meredith Gardner, at far left, working with cryptanalysts.jpg
File:Decryption of Soviet Diplomatic Telegram Relating to the Code Name "Enormous" and Photography of Material - NARA - 595374 (page 1).jpg

szenen.text: It began in *1943* and ran until 1980.
Soviet cables were meant to be *unbreakable.*
But code clerks *reused* keys. That was the crack.
Decrypts helped *expose* spies inside the atomic program.

archiv.datei: File:Decision to maintain contact with Theodore Hall 1944.gif

szenen.text: The public learned of it only in *1995.*

archiv.datei: File:Decryption of Soviet Diplomatic Telegram Relating to the Code Name "Enormous" and Photography of Material - NARA - 595374 (page 3).jpg

szenen.text: A secret kept for *50 years.* Who is reading your messages today?
